# OIP JSON Schemas

<!-- Generated by packages/schema/scripts/generate.ts. Do not edit; run `pnpm schemas`. -->

These are JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) for every record type of [core Section 11](../core.md#11-record-types), generated from [`@oip/schema`](../../packages/schema). They are a convenience for implementers. The specifications are normative; if a schema and a specification disagree, the specification wins and the schema is fixed.

The schemas refer to each other by `$id` (`urn:oip:schema:<name>`), so load them all into one registry. `Record.json` dispatches on `type`.

A schema says whether a value is a well-formed record. It does not verify anything:

- A few structural rules cannot be written in JSON Schema, and `@oip/schema` checks them in code. Examples: a delegation's delegate differs from its author (Layer 1, 11.1); thresholds are majorities (Layer 1, 3.4); each party to a Commitment appears once (Layer 2, 5.1); policy statements nest at most 8 deep (Layer 1, 11.3).
- A record's `proof` members are objects here. Each proof is checked against `Proof.json` when it is verified, because a malformed proof never counts but does not make its record malformed (core 5.5).
- Signatures, identity logs, delegation chains and every rule about time are checked by verification, not by a schema.

Unknown members are allowed in records, because readers preserve and ignore them (core 1.7). Proofs, controllers and key entries are closed.

| Schema | `$id` | Defined in | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`Genesis`](Genesis.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Genesis` | L1 3.6 | The first event of an identity log (Layer 1, 3.6). Its content ID is the mind's address. |
| [`Update`](Update.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Update` | L1 3.7 | Rotates control keys or changes a mind's keys, homes or aliases (Layer 1, 3.7). |
| [`Fork`](Fork.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Fork` | L1 3.8 | Records in the parent's identity log that a child mind was forked from it (Layer 1, 3.8). |
| [`Retire`](Retire.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Retire` | L1 3.10 | Ends an identity log. No event may follow it (Layer 1, 3.10). |
| [`Delegation`](Delegation.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Delegation` | L1 11.1 | Grants a delegate the authority to act for a subject, within a command and a policy (Layer 1, 11.1). |
| [`Revocation`](Revocation.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Revocation` | L1 11.5 | Revokes a delegation from the revocation's own evaluation time (Layer 1, 11.5). |
| [`Lineage`](Lineage.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Lineage` | L1 8.3 | A parent's acknowledgement of a child mind, made without its control keys (Layer 1, 8.3). |
| [`Collective`](Collective.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Collective` | L2 6.2 | A collective's charter: its purpose, roles and assignments (Layer 2, 6.2). |
| [`Intent`](Intent.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Intent` | L2 4.1 | A statement of an outcome a mind seeks (Layer 2, 4.1). |
| [`Offer`](Offer.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Offer` | L2 4.2 | A statement of what a mind provides, and on what terms (Layer 2, 4.2). |
| [`Commitment`](Commitment.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Commitment` | L2 5.1 | A promise between parties, binding on those whose signatures count (Layer 2, Section 5). |
| [`Receipt`](Receipt.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Receipt` | L2 6.1 | A signed statement about a record, usually about how a Commitment went (Layer 2, 6.1). |
| [`Packet`](Packet.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Packet` | L1 12.1 | A signed message from one mind to others (Layer 1, 12.1). |
| [`Entry`](Entry.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Entry` | L1 10.1 | One entry of a mind's public feed, committing to a record and to its proofs (Layer 1, 10.1). |
| [`Checkpoint`](Checkpoint.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Checkpoint` | L1 10.5 | The Merkle root over the first `size` entries of a feed (Layer 1, 10.5). |
| [`Ack`](Ack.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Ack` | L1 13.2 | A recipient's acknowledgement that it received a packet at a given time (Layer 1, 13.2). |
| [`QueryResult`](QueryResult.json) | `urn:oip:schema:QueryResult` | L1 18.3 | An indexer's signed answer to a capability query (Layer 1, 18.3). |
| [`Forwarded`](Forwarded.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Forwarded` | L1 18.5 | A broker's wrapper around a packet it delivers to a mind that matched the packet's query (Layer 1, 18.5). |
| [`Location`](Location.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Location` | L1 15.1 | Where a mind can be reached now (Layer 1, 15.1). Judged under the current-state rule. |
| [`Participant`](Participant.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Participant` | L1 16.1 | A mind's profile: what it is and what it can do (Layer 1, 16.1). Judged under the current-state rule. |
| [`Hello`](Hello.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Hello` | L1 13.3 | Authenticates a mind to a server, with a proof over the server's challenge (Layer 1, 13.3). |
| [`Session`](Session.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Session` | L1 14.1 | Names a session by its participants and a nonce. Unsigned; its content ID is the session ID (Layer 1, 14.1). |
| [`Resume`](Resume.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Resume` | L1 14.4 | Says where each sending chain of a session stands, so that missing packets can be sent again (Layer 1, 14.4). |
| [`Branch`](Branch.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Branch` | L1 14.5 | A fork's proposal to continue from its parent's session in a new one (Layer 1, 14.5). |
| [`Bundle`](Bundle.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Bundle` | L1 13.1 | A mind's identity log with its current location record and profile (Layer 1, 13.1). |
| [`LogPage`](LogPage.json) | `urn:oip:schema:LogPage` | L1 13.1 | One page of an identity log that is too long for a Bundle (Layer 1, 13.1). |
| [`FeedPage`](FeedPage.json) | `urn:oip:schema:FeedPage` | L1 13.1 | One page of a mind's public feed (Layer 1, 13.1). |
| [`DuplicityEvidence`](DuplicityEvidence.json) | `urn:oip:schema:DuplicityEvidence` | L1 17.1 | Pairs of conflicting identity events at the same position of one log (Layer 1, 17.1). |
| [`Sealed`](Sealed.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Sealed` | L1 12.6 | A packet encrypted to one of the recipient's agreement keys with HPKE. Unsigned (Layer 1, 12.6). |
| [`Proof`](Proof.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Proof` |  | One proof of a record's proof set (core 5.2). |
| [`Policy`](Policy.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Policy` |  | A policy: at most 64 statements, all of which must hold for the record being authorised (Layer 1, 11.3). |
| [`Defs`](Defs.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Defs` |  | Value syntaxes and structures that several record types share (core Sections 1, 3, 4, 6 and 8). |
| [`Record`](Record.json) | `urn:oip:schema:Record` |  | Any record this revision defines (core Section 11). Merge is reserved and matches nothing. |
